pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding positions within 5 minutes or 2 dollars of an active loss; scale-in only permitted after the initial trade achieves +$10 unrealized profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order block validation and spread normalization check (< 30 pips) prior to execution; absolute ban on entries during top-tier high-impact news windows.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop locking at +$10 profit, scaling out fractional lots to guarantee the $15-$30+ win target.
